item.title: Drone Warrior
item.description: "Two weeks after the war began, the woman who would later revolutionize Ukraine’s drone capabilities was driving through a town near Kyiv when her car came under Russian fire. Iryna Terekh, the young owner of a small furniture company, sped out of the town of Bucha with her ailing mother in the passenger seat. She published a photo of a bullet hole in her car’s rear bumper—and a defiant manifesto. “I’m one of those women who doesn’t know how to fight,” she wrote on Instagram in March 2022. “But I’m sure of one thing: I’ll do absolutely everything in my power to make sure nothing of this sort ever happens in my country again.” Today, the 34-year-old Terekh is chief executive and chief technical officer of Fire Point, a defense company with 7,000 employees whose long-range drones and missiles are hitting targets across Russia and helping Ukraine to shift the balance of the war. Her Instagram page once featured wholesome photos of architecture. Now it shows videos of exploding Russian warehouses and power plants—hit by the weaponry that Terekh helped design. “I would never have gotten involved with weapons if my country wasn’t invaded,” Terekh told The Wall Street Journal. " https://www.wsj.com/world/ukraine-fire-point-ceo-iryna-terekh-drones-d93ec97b

item.description: Governor Greg Abbott turned Texas into a sanctuary state for one ICE agent. Christian Castro shot a Venezuelan man through the front door of a Minneapolis home in January, then lied about it so thoroughly that federal prosecutors charged the man he shot. Minnesota later charged Castro with felony assault, Texas Rangers arrested him, and a judge has held him in jail since May. On Tuesday, Minnesota asked a federal court to force his extradition. Abbott doesn't dispute the charges or the warrant, but still won't sign. He says he won't respond at all until Minnesota repays the federal government for welfare fraud. item.title: The Last Human - Bedtime [OC]
item.description:
Fun fact! Thought it's been over a thousand years since the last confirmed sighting of a Human, many cultures still tell "Human stories." Though these tellings span dozens of cultures and hundreds of lightyears, there is some universal advice: (1) Never tell a Human your true name (i.e. Network designation). (2) Never eat their food. (3) If you *do* end up in the hideous five-fingered hands of a Human, all hope is not lost! They are easily distracted by shiny objects. - I'm going to assume that anyone still reading is at least somewhat interested in the comic, so I'll tell you why this episode did NOT go into the book. Yes, yes, murder your darlings and all that, but also *cannibalize* your darlings. This episode had three pieces I wanted to use elsewhere. (1) A hunter-killer sprinting to the aid of its screaming offspring (which every parent understands): stolen for https://ACrowdedGalaxy.com/read/AmEaq0l3jqGL. (2) Bedtime, because that turned into a whole two chapters. And (3) the comforting realization that nothing is scarier than mommy. Here's what we did with that one:
So if I can leave you with one piece of advice, it's that: Cannibalize your darlings. As always, plenty more at https://ACrowdedGalaxy.com.
